subject: [PATCH v4 4/8] mm/mmzone: read each zoneref slot once when filtering by nodemask

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Identified that zonelist_node_idx() reads nid from the zone, not part of zoneref. Suggested that the patch is actually equivalent to the original implementation with READ_ONCE().

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch addresses a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug by reading each zoneref slot only once when filtering by nodemask. The current implementation reads the slot twice, which can lead to a crash when offlining a zone's last block. The patch fixes this issue by removing the redundant read and ensuring that a NULL zone terminates the walk.
